words.gloss: the employee / one who performs the work

parts.gloss: will not swerve / will not go astray

literal: Daily let examine the king the worker's unswerving conduct; [if so,] will not swerve the world.
translation: Let the king daily examine the conduct of his officers; as long as they do not swerve from their duty, the world will not swerve from its path.
modern: அரசன் தன் தொழிலைச் செய்பவனுடைய நேர்மையை நாள்தோறும் ஆராய வேண்டும்; அவன் கோணாமல் கடமை ஆற்றினால், உலகமும் தன் நல்ல நிலையிலிருந்து கோணாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the importance of constant supervision in governance. The king (மன்னன்) must daily (நாடோறும்) watch and evaluate (நாடுக) the integrity and unswerving nature (கோடாமை) of his officers (வினைசெய்வான்). If the administrators perform their duties uprightly without bending the rules, the subjects of the world (உலகு) will also remain orderly and will not go astray (கோடாது). The stability of the entire society depends on this daily vigilance over those who hold executive power.
